text:
Alice Chen: Quick sync — we need a clear dependency map and single critical path for the upcoming quarter (Dedicated + Private launch scope). Please call out blockers, hard dates, and owners. Can folks post brief ETA + blockers by EOD Wed?

Marco Ruiz: On it. I'll assemble a sequencing draft for runtime, model onboarding, and rollout phases. Need SRE + Infra confirmation on capacity windows.

Samir Patel: Heads up — us-west GPU capacity is constrained in weeks 28-32 due to partner maintenance. I can reserve burst pool but need commit by next Tue. Blocker: final instance types from infra procurement.

Nina Gomez: SRE note: we must have a feature-flag plan for graceful fallback to smaller models. Also we need clear SLOs for canary traffic (p90 latency target).

Priya Rao: From evals: quantization regressions have shown a 2–3% quality delta on reranking tests. Quant pipeline (eng-ml) needs 2 weeks of tuning + baseline evals. That blocks embeddings infra decisions.

Liam Park: Design ask: staged onboarding + customer opt-in for Dedicated. Design can deliver flows by 2024-07-25 if PMs freeze acceptance criteria this Friday.

Ellen Torres: Sales impact — Enterprise X requires private deployment available by end of Q. If that date slips, we lose the deal. They accept an initial constrained feature set but need VPC + KMS.

Alice Chen: Draft critical path (proposed) — please react with :thumbsup: if you agree or reply with a single-line objection.

```
Milestone          | Owner         | ETA        | Blocker
-------------------|---------------|------------|---------------------------
Kernel selection   | Marco Ruiz    | 2024-07-12 | perf benchmarks pending
Quant + evals      | Priya Rao     | 2024-07-26 | infra testbeds, data sets
Capacity config    | Samir Patel   | 2024-07-30 | instance proc & budget
Feature flags SRE  | Nina Gomez    | 2024-08-04 | flagging infra + tests
Canary rollout     | Marco Ruiz    | 2024-08-12 | capacity + KB cache ready
Customer onboarding | Liam Park     | 2024-08-20 | PM acceptance criteria
```

Marco Ruiz: :thumbsup: I can move kernel selection earlier by 3 days if eng-runtime prioritizes perf benchmarks (I’ll ping eng-runtime).

Samir Patel: :thumbsup: I can reserve burst pool but need budget approval. If we miss Tue commit, ETA shifts 2 weeks.

Priya Rao: Objection — quant tuning likely needs 3 weeks not 2, given current regressions. Suggest move quant + evals to 2024-08-02.

Nina Gomez: Agree with Priya. Also add requirement: golden traffic replay dataset for canary validation (will take SRE + DS to prepare).

Liam Park: Noted. If PMs freeze acceptance criteria Friday, design timeline stands.

Ellen Torres: Can we ship VPC + KMS subset earlier to unblock sales? Minimal compliance packaging would be fine.

Alice Chen: Updated asks: Priya/Nina — re-evaluate quant ETA and dataset prep. Samir — push for budget signoff Tue. Marco — move perf bench forward. Liam — draft minimal VPC onboarding flow for early ship. I'll consolidate and post an updated dependency map tomorrow morning.

roadmap-bot: Reminder — product dependency sync scheduled Thu 09:30. Agenda: finalize critical path, confirm ETAs, list hard blockers.

Marco Ruiz: I'll produce a lean dependency diagram (edges + owners) and post as a GDrive link by 08:30 tomorrow.

Alice Chen: Thanks all — short follow-up: please add any hard no-go dates for your teams to the shared doc I created: <link> (only add lines, no comment threads).
